bean.prompt: Create an animation authoring sheet for the SAME heavy bean creature as the reference. Clean hand-painted 2D game sprite art, broad stable shading, restrained outlines, no noisy texture. TRUE transparent background, no shadows below any drawing, no floor, no text. EXACT grid FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight separated cells with generous padding. TOP ROW: (1) complete neutral squat footless heavy cream bean creature with its two-leaf sprout and open dot eyes; (2) complete anticipation key pose, belly lowered, closed eyes, sprout leaning forward; (3) complete spreading metamorphosis key pose, belly spreading equally left and right, still centered, sprout rising; (4) isolated pair of CLOSED eyes. BOTTOM ROW: (5) complete blank cream torso with NO eyes and NO sprout, same neutral silhouette and shaded surface as cell1; (6) complete two-leaf sprout with its stem and hidden lower connection fully drawn; (7) isolated pair of OPEN eyes; (8) complete shallow cream front belly rim, an elongated rounded organic band used as an independently articulated foreground occluder, same material as torso. The creature has NO legs, feet, arms, hands or tail. Keep the torso broad, massive and low, not a thin upright character. All shapes clean and readable, no ground or cast shadow. This is production source art, not a labeled diagram.
